name: **[Storra (Cloud Storage Platform)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Personal-Google-Drive)** | Node.js, React.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, Cloudflare R2
highlights: Engineered a cloud storage platform using React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Cloudflare R2, enabling secure direct browser uploads/downloads via S3-compatible presigned URLs while eliminating backend proxying for file transfers.
Designed a webhook-driven subscription system integrating Razorpay, implementing plan upgrades, downgrades, grace periods, storage quota enforcement, and idempotent billing event processing.
Implemented hierarchical file management with path-aware directories, recursive descendant counting, and bulk deletion of nested folders and Cloudflare R2 objects.

Strengthened application security by enforcing constrained presigned uploads, CSRF protection with SameSite=Strict cookies, webhook verification, and custom CORS middleware for state-changing requests.

name: **[ShipIt (Self-Hosted CI/CD Server)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/ShipIt-Self-Hoster-CI-CD-Server.git)** | Node.js, PM2, Telegram API, Octokit, AWS S3 + CloudFront
highlights: Built a self-hosted CI/CD server using GitHub Webhooks, SSH, PM2, and Node.js to automatically deploy applications without relying on third-party CI platforms.
Orchestrated zero-downtime deployments through timestamped release directories, symlink-based version switching, automated health checks, and rollback to the last healthy release.
Optimized deployment workflows by detecting dependency changes across all commits in a push event, avoiding unnecessary package installations and reducing deployment time.
Integrated GitHub Commit Status APIs, Telegram deployment notifications, Redis-backed log storage, and AWS S3/CloudFront frontend deployments into a unified deployment pipeline.

name: **[Video Streaming Platform](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Video-Streaming)** | AWS, Node.js, React, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, ECS Fargate, S3, CloudFront, FFmpeg, MongoDB, Docker
highlights: Architected a cloud-native video streaming platform on AWS with event-driven transcoding, adaptive bitrate HLS streaming, and secure content delivery using CloudFront signed cookies.
Implemented direct browser uploads to Amazon S3 using presigned URLs and asynchronous transcoding by triggering ECS Fargate workers from S3 events through AWS Lambda.
Developed an FFmpeg-based transcoding pipeline that generates multi-bitrate HLS renditions (360p,480p, and 720p) and publishes segmented media to S3 for adaptive playback.

Secured video playback by issuing CloudFront signed cookies scoped to individual video assets, enabling time-limited authorization for HLS playlists and media segments without exposing storage objects.
